name: @systemfsoftware/stryker-bench
description: Report-only A/B bench orchestrator for main: each push to main is benched against the lane's last green main commit over the legs Turbo reports affected since then (the full corpus on a dispatch, a change to the lane's own inputs, or no green ancestor, when side A is the first parent), interleaved over two corpora, reading each run's own NDJSON. each leg job's 20-minute timeout is the only kill (the plan job keeps 60); the leg's wall time is reported against its 10-minute target, never enforced.

scripts.lint:tsgo: effect-tsgo diagnostics --project tsconfig.app.json --format ${TSGO_FORMAT:-text} && effect-tsgo diagnostics --project tsconfig.test.json --format ${TSGO_FORMAT:-text}
